name: circuits
definition: 举办赛车比赛的固定场地设施，具有名称、所在地理位置（经纬度、海拔）与所属国家等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「比赛事件(races)」混淆：赛道是长期存在的物理场地，比赛是在该场地上于特定日期举行的一次赛事。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table circuits; provenance: direct source circuits

name: constructors
definition: 以组织名义报名参赛并制造或运营赛车的实体，具有名称与所属国家等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车手(drivers)」混淆：车队是组织实体，车手是自然人参赛者。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table constructors; provenance: direct source constructors

name: constructorResults
definition: 车队单场成绩 Counterexample: 易与「车队积分榜(constructorStandings)」混淆：前者是单场比赛的结果，后者是截至某场比赛的累计排名。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table constructorResults; provenance: direct source constructorResults

name: constructorStandings
definition: 截至某一场比赛时某车队在赛季中的累计排名记录，具有所属比赛、所属车队、累计积分、名次与胜场数等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车队单场成绩(constructorResults)」混淆：积分榜是累计统计快照，单场成绩只反映一场比赛。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table constructorStandings; provenance: direct source constructorStandings

name: races
definition: 在特定赛道于特定日期举行的一站赛事，具有所属赛季年份、轮次、赛道、名称与日期时间等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「赛道(circuits)」混淆：比赛是有时间限定的赛事事件，赛道是其举办地点。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table races; provenance: direct source races

name: drivers
definition: 以自然人身份参加赛车比赛并驾驶赛车的参赛者，具有姓名、出生日期、国籍与车号等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车队(constructors)」混淆：车手是自然人，车队是组织实体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table drivers; provenance: direct source drivers

name: results
definition: 车手单场成绩 Counterexample: 易与「车队单场成绩(constructorResults)」混淆：前者以车手为记录主体，后者以车队为记录主体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table results; provenance: direct source results

name: driverStandings
definition: 截至某一场比赛时某车手在赛季中的累计排名记录，具有所属比赛、车手、累计积分、名次与胜场数等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车手单场成绩(results)」混淆：积分榜是累计统计快照，单场成绩只反映一场比赛。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table driverStandings; provenance: direct source driverStandings

name: status
definition: 用于描述比赛结果中完赛或退赛情形的状态分类条目，具有状态标识与状态名称等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「比赛(races)」混淆：状态是描述结果的分类码值，不是赛事本身。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table status; provenance: direct source status

name: seasons
definition: 以年份标识的一个完整比赛周期，具有年份与说明链接等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「比赛(races)」混淆：赛季是跨多站比赛的年度周期，比赛是其中单站赛事。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table seasons; provenance: direct source seasons

name: lapTimes
definition: 单圈用时 Counterexample: 易与「进站记录(pitStops)」混淆：单圈用时记录整圈行驶耗时，进站记录只记录维修区停留。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table lapTimes; provenance: direct source lapTimes

name: pitStops
definition: 某车手在某场比赛中进入维修区停留的记录，具有所属比赛、车手、进站次序、圈号与停留时长等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「单圈用时(lapTimes)」混淆：进站记录只覆盖维修区停留时段，单圈用时覆盖整圈行驶。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table pitStops; provenance: direct source pitStops

name: qualifying
definition: 排位赛成绩 Counterexample: 易与「车手单场成绩(results)」混淆：排位赛成绩决定发车顺序，正赛成绩记录最终比赛结果。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table qualifying; provenance: direct source qualifying

name: Driver
definition: A Formula 1 driver identified by driverId, with full name from forename and surname, and code as the abbreviated code.

name: DriverNationality
definition: The nationality attribute of a driver.

name: DriverDateOfBirth
definition: The date of birth of a driver, used to compute age or birth year.

name: Constructor
definition: A Formula 1 constructor/team identified by constructorId, with reference name and nationality.

name: ConstructorNationality
definition: The nationality attribute of a constructor.

name: Race
definition: A Formula 1 race event identified by raceId, with name, year, round, date and circuit.

name: RaceName
definition: The official name of a race event.

name: RaceYear
definition: The season year in which a race took place.

name: RaceDate
definition: The calendar date on which a race took place.

name: Circuit
definition: A racing circuit identified by circuitId, with name, location, country and coordinates.

name: CircuitCountry
definition: The country in which a circuit is located.

name: CircuitCoordinates
definition: The latitude and longitude coordinates of a circuit.

name: RaceResult
definition: A driver's result in a race, including finishing position, points, laps and time.

name: RaceCompletion
definition: Whether a driver completed a race, indicated by a non-null time value in results.
scope: results where time IS NOT NULL

name: Points
definition: The championship points scored by a driver or constructor in a race or standings.

name: Wins
definition: The number of race wins recorded for a driver or constructor.

name: FastestLap
definition: The fastest lap achieved by a driver in a race, recorded as lap number and time.
scope: results where fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL

name: LapTime
definition: The time taken to complete a lap, recorded in milliseconds.

name: LapNumber
definition: The sequential number of a lap within a race.

name: Qualifying
definition: A driver's qualifying performance in a race, with Q1, Q2 and Q3 times and position.

name: PitStop
definition: A pit stop made by a driver during a race, with stop number and duration.

name: Status
definition: The finishing status of a driver in a race.

name: RaceCompletionRate
definition: The percentage of drivers who completed a race out of all drivers in that race. Formula: COUNT(RaceCompletion) / COUNT(RaceResult). Inputs: RaceCompletion = results.time WHERE time IS NOT NULL; RaceResult = results.resultId

name: AverageLapTime
definition: The average lap time in milliseconds for a driver in a race. Formula: AVG(LapTime). Inputs: LapTime = lapTimes.milliseconds

name: DriverWinCount
definition: The total number of race wins for a driver. Formula: SUM(Wins). Inputs: Wins = driverStandings.wins; Driver = drivers.driverId

name: ConstructorWinCount
definition: The total number of race wins for a constructor. Formula: SUM(Wins). Inputs: Wins = driverStandings.wins; Constructor = constructors.constructorId

name: DriverMaxPoints
definition: The maximum points scored by a driver in a single race or season. Formula: MAX(Points). Inputs: Points = results.points; Driver = drivers.driverId

name: ConstructorTotalPoints
definition: The total points scored by a constructor. Formula: SUM(Points). Inputs: Points = results.points; Constructor = constructors.constructorId

name: DriverAge
definition: The age of a driver computed from date of birth. Formula: YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - YEAR(DriverDateOfBirth). Inputs: DriverDateOfBirth = drivers.dob

name: FastestLapSpeed
definition: The speed achieved on the fastest lap. Formula: MAX(fastestLapSpeed). Inputs: FastestLap = results.fastestLapTime WHERE fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL

name: QualifyingPosition
definition: The position achieved in qualifying. Formula: MIN(Qualifying.position). Inputs: Qualifying = qualifying.qualifyId

name: PitStopAverageDuration
definition: The average duration of pit stops for a driver or race. Formula: AVG(PitStop.duration). Inputs: PitStop = pitStops.stop

name: LapCount
definition: The total number of laps completed by a driver in a race. Formula: COUNT(LapNumber). Inputs: LapNumber = lapTimes.lap

name: PointsPercentage
definition: The share of points scored relative to the maximum possible. Formula: SUM(Points) / MAX(Points). Inputs: Points = results.points

name: DriverNationality
definition: Analysis of drivers by their nationality.

name: ConstructorNationality
definition: Analysis of constructors by their nationality.

name: CircuitCountry
definition: Analysis of circuits by their host country.

name: RaceName
definition: Analysis of races by their official name.

name: Status
definition: Analysis of race results by finishing status.
